cc: *@umesh* and *@pramod*
Here is the latest automated test execution report for the *Infra Projects* module.

*Test Scenarios Summary:*

*1. Navigate to Infra Projects -> Project List* :white_check_mark:
• *Description:* Verified sidebar menu navigation to `Infra Projects` and opening `Project List`.
• *Result:* Navigated to `/projects` with `Create Project` action button visible (Duration: 4.58s).

*2. Create Project with Infrastructure Setup* :white_check_mark:
• *Description:* Completed 4-step wizard with *Infrastructure Setup* checkbox enabled.
• *Result:* Dynamic dates, nickname, address, services, and Infrastructure enabled flag submitted (Duration: 36.12s).

*3. Verify Project Details Page & Infrastructure Tab* :white_check_mark:
• *Description:* Opened project details, verified *Project Profile* card, tabs, and *Infrastructure* module.
• *Result:* Profile verified, navigation tabs confirmed (`Profile`, `Organization`, `Teams`, `Infrastructure`, `Directory`, `Documents`, `Cost Center`, `Work Order`, `Setting`), and *Infrastructure Tab* clicked displaying root node, node list tree, progress, weightage, and timeline (Duration: 18.25s).

elements.text: Automated Test Suite • Selenium WebDriver 4.21 • Java 21 • Report saved in `test_report.html` and `test_report.csv`
